Description

The GW10K-EHA-G20 is the 10 kW single-phase ESA G20 power module: 10.0 kVA rated backup, 20.0 kW PV on 4 MPPT trackers (1/1/1/1), backup 10.0 (20.0, 10 s).

Description Technical data Documents

GoodWe ESA GW10K-EHA-G20 (10 kW single-phase power module)

  • 10.0 kVA rated backup; max 10.0 (20.0, 10 s); from-grid 14.5 kVA (63 A internal bypass on this column).

  • 20.0 kW maximum PV input on 4 MPPTs (1/1/1/1), 20 A / 26 A Isc.

  • Battery window 350–550 V; charge 13.5 kW at 35.6 A, discharge 11.0 kW at 29.0 A.

  • IP66, natural convection, 26 kg, 800 × 300 × 270 mm.

10.0 kVA rated backup.

Rated backup 10.0 kVA. Maximum 10.0 (20.0, 10 s). From-grid 14.5 kVA (63 A internal bypass on this column). Switching <4 ms. IP66, wall or floor mounted, −35 to +60 °C.

11.0 kW maximum battery discharge at 29.0 A

One battery input. Charge 13.5 kW at 35.6 A, discharge 11.0 kW at 29.0 A, 350–550 V, nominal 380 V, start-up 380 V. Battery-to-AC efficiency 97.8%.

20.0 kW PV input across 4 MPPTs

4 MPPTs, strings 1/1/1/1, 20 A / 26 A Isc. Max PV 20.0 kW, MPPT window 40–560 V, start-up 50 V, max 600 V.

Product questions

What backup rating does GW10K-EHA-G20 have?

For the GW10K-EHA-G20, the backup side nominal output apparent power is 10 kVA. The maximum output apparent power is 10.0 kVA (20.0 kVA for 10 s), and the maximum output apparent power in bypass is 14.5 kVA. Nominal output current is 43.5 A at 220 V, 43.5 A at 230 V and 41.7 A at 240 V; the maximum output current is listed with the same values. The maximum bypass output current is 63 A.

How many MPPTs does GW10K-EHA-G20 have?

The GW10K-EHA-G20 has 4 MPPTs. Each MPPT has 1 string.

Which battery modules stack with this power module?

The following battery modules stack with the GW10K-EHA-G20: GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Battery modules of different models support mixed use.
